How we work

FROM AN IDEA
to a live site.

The scope, content, and next steps
are agreed before the build begins.

  1. 01

    Discover

    We discuss your audience, goals, content, and the features the website needs.

  2. 02

    Define

    We set out the pages, deliverables, and schedule so the work has a clear direction.

  3. 03

    Design & build

    You review the visual direction and working site as we develop the experience.

  4. 04

    Launch & hand over

    We prepare the production site and walk you through its content and everyday use.

Before we start

A few useful
answers.

How much does a website cost?+

Each project is scoped around its pages, content, and features. After a conversation, we agree the deliverables and price before work starts.

Can we work together remotely?+

Yes. Webly is based in India and can collaborate remotely through calls, shared previews, and written feedback.

Can I update the website myself?+

If the project needs regular updates, we can include an admin interface for the content you want to manage. We agree this as part of the scope.

Can you work with an existing website or identity?+

Yes. We can work with the material you have, redesign an existing site, or develop a new visual direction for the website.
